## Vowel means (F1, F2 Hz; n tokens): FAILED SANITY CHECK, DO NOT USE

THOUGHT ("call") comes out with F2 above 2000 Hz and LOT ("Bob") with F1 near 400 Hz, which is impossible for
these back/low vowels: the Whisper word windows plus automatic formant tracking on these MP3s are not reliable.
Vowel claims in STUDY.md come from the published studies instead. Fix: forced alignment (e.g. Montreal Forced
Aligner) and hand-checked tokens.
